tax-filing-position-consequences v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a skill to surface second-order effects from tax elections/positions that affect more than one year.
- Activates only when a client's question or positions have multi-year consequences (e.g., entity choice, depreciation elections, Roth conversion).
- Includes triggers, practical examples, red flags, and verification checklist for best-practice review.
- Focuses on modeling multi-year impacts rather than year-only optimization.
- Integrates with deciqAI’s open-source knowledge skills platform.
